title: Black sites staffed by refugees who didn't make the P3 cut

tellings.quote: They got their own people to manage these things like these refugees they get from these other countries that they scream for P3 that don't cut make the cut. Well, they have them as janitors, cooks, you know, people to maintain these facilities.

plain: The secret facilities known as black sites are run by their own hand-picked people, and the janitors, cooks and maintenance staff are refugees from other countries who applied to a programme he calls P3 and did not make the cut. Michael Herrera, a guest who says he saw a huge craft in the Indonesian jungle, tells Michels this as something he was told. He does not explain P3 or name who told him.
